Eli (sales): Launch PM needs a clear capacity plan for enterprise commit: peak ~2k qps for chat+embeds, short bursty events. Questions: reserved GPU rec, autoscale behavior, prewarm, security checklist.
Nora (solutions): Are spikes scheduled or ad-hoc?
Launch PM: Mostly scheduled launches but sometimes surprise spikes. baseline ~100 rps, spikes to 2k for 10-20m, ~8 times/month.
Toby (eng-infra): Perf estimate: redwood-llama-8b-q ~300 qps/node mixed -> 7 nodes to hit 2.1k. Recommend 7 reserved for SLA needs, or 3-4 reserved + autoscale to handle spikes.
Iris (sre): Coldstarts add tail latency (5-30s). Mitigate with prewarm jobs and KV warmers. For scheduled launches we can run a prewarm 5-10m prior.
Eli (sales): Can we show a cost example for reserve vs hybrid?
Toby (eng-infra): Quick calc: extra node ~0.13$/min. A 15m spike with +4 nodes -> ~7.8$ per spike. At 8 spikes -> ~62.4/mo. Reserved 7 nodes = stable monthly commit (we'll provide exact price in proposal).
Sam (security): Dedicated supports customer KMS and VPC peering. Audit logs default 90d; enterprise retention is add-on. I'll fill questionnaire items around KMS rotation and egress rules.
Launch PM: We require AZ spread and explicit fallback model clause. Also need a playbook for warm vs cold decision.
Iris (sre): Playbook (summary): if spikes scheduled -> prewarm 5-10m; if unpredictable & frequent -> raise reserved baseline; if unpredictable & rare -> autoscale+fallback variant.
Nora (solutions): Action items: Toby run perf sim with customer's trace, Iris draft prewarm/fallback runbook, Sam finish security answers, Eli draft SOW with AZ/fallback clause.
Toby (eng-infra): Perf sim job submitted; will upload numbers shortly.
Eli (sales): Thanks team — will present options on Friday call once sim & security answers are in.
